name: Zab-al-ack
meaning: A single Z route ends in a lifted acknowledgement terminal, reflecting durable delivery from one human action in Alerta to its original scoped Zabbix problem.

construction.mark: One solid path; no detached badge, strokes, gradients or embedded imagery.
construction.wordmark: Eight outlined lowercase letters and a circular amber period; no runtime font dependency.
construction.icon: Navy mark on an amber rounded square; the same mark geometry at every size.

clear_space.rule: Keep at least one top-bar thickness (64 mark units) clear on every side of the complete mark or wordmark.
clear_space.compact_ui_exception: Supplied favicon and app icon include their own optical padding; do not add external padding inside their square.

minimum_sizes.guidance: At 16–23 px, prefer the supplied favicon composition; reserve the full wordmark for widths of 176 px or more.

variants.zabalack-mark-dark.svg: Ivory for dark backgrounds or reversed monochrome use.
variants.zabalack-mark-mono.svg: Navy for light backgrounds and one-color output.
variants.zabalack-logo-light.svg: Amber mark and period with navy letters on ivory or white.
variants.zabalack-logo-dark.svg: Amber mark and period with ivory letters on navy.
variants.favicon.svg: Navy mark on amber, optimized padded composition for 16–32 px.
variants.zabalack-app-icon.svg: 512 px master of the same icon composition.

usage: Preserve the silhouette, clear inner pocket and lifted terminal.
Use the matching logo variant for the background.
Keep the amber period in primary wordmarks; keep it monochrome in the mono version.
Do not stretch, outline, rotate, add gradients, shadows, textures or detached check badges.
The visual wordmark is zabalack.; the official project name remains Zab-al-ack. This identity does not rename a repository, package, API or command.
Do not describe the mark as many-alert aggregation, automatic re-acknowledgement, full synchronization or bidirectional writes.
rights_note: Original, project-owned branding supplied under the project Apache-2.0 license. No trademark registration or affiliation claim is made.
validation: All SVG lettering is real paths; no fonts or bitmap embeds.
Every mark variant uses the same canonical path.
No scripts, external URLs, filters, masks or clipping dependencies.
Rendered and inspected at 16, 24 and 32 px; header lockups checked at 180 and 208 px.
